→ This isn’t just physical exhaustion. It’s your body and energy system recalibrating. Old energies, limiting beliefs, and outdated patterns are releasing, making space for the new. During this time, honor your need for rest. Take naps, slow your pace, and avoid pushing through exhaustion. Your body needs this downtime to integrate the shift fully.

2. You crave distance from others.
→ This desire for solitude is an internal call to reconnect with yourself. Use this sacred pause to quiet external noise. Spend time journaling, meditating, or simply being present with your thoughts. Strengthen your energetic boundaries and listen closely to your intuition. The clearer your inner voice becomes, the easier it will be to navigate your next steps.

3. Your interests feel dull or uninspiring.
→ When old joys fade without explanation, it’s often your soul clearing space for something new and authentic. Instead of forcing motivation or chasing what no longer lights you up, listen deeply to your inner guidance. Trust that this clearing is creating space for fresh opportunities and a deeper sense of purpose to emerge.

✦ Acknowledge these signs as  invitations to slow down, trust the process, and embrace your own timing. Be patient with yourself, hold your vision, protect your energy, and honor exactly where you are right now. Your reality is shifting!
